requirement: Fix the bug in the existing checkout service where duplicate orders are created.
problem_statement: Change existing behaviour safely: "Fix the bug in the existing checkout service where duplicate orders are created". Preserve public behaviour except where intentionally changed, proven by tests written before the change.

ambiguities.question: What is the expected vs actual behaviour and how is it reproduced?
ambiguities.assumption: The first task produces a failing test that defines expected behaviour.

assumptions: reproduction details: The first task produces a failing test that defines expected behaviour.

tasks.title: Understand existing behaviour and reproduce the issue

ai_assist.prompt: Requirement: "Fix the bug in the existing checkout service where duplicate orders are created.". Given the relevant existing code, explain current behaviour, where it deviates from expectation, and how to reproduce it.
ai_assist.ai_role: Reads and explains unfamiliar code; suggests reproduction.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Confirms the explanation by running the code; never trusts it unverified.

tasks.title: Add characterization / failing tests first
deliverables: Test that fails for the bug or pins current behaviour

ai_assist.prompt: Write pytest tests that pin the current behaviour around "Fix the bug in the existing checkout service where duplicate orders are created." and one that fails for the reported defect.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Confirms the new test fails for the right reason before any fix.

validation: Failing test fails on unchanged code

ai_assist.prompt: Propose the minimal change for "Fix the bug in the existing checkout service where duplicate orders are created." that preserves public behaviour; list alternatives and blast radius.
ai_assist.ai_role: Proposes options and enumerates impacted callers.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Chooses the option; verifies callers via search, not memory.

ai_assist.prompt: Implement the planned change for "Fix the bug in the existing checkout service where duplicate orders are created." with a minimal diff. Do not alter unrelated code.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Reads every changed line; rejects unrelated edits.

ai_assist.prompt: Extend tests for "Fix the bug in the existing checkout service where duplicate orders are created.": boundaries, error paths and regression guards for neighbouring behaviour.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Checks coverage did not fall and tests are meaningful.

tasks.title: Update docs and changelog

ai_assist.prompt: Update documentation and changelog for the change described by "Fix the bug in the existing checkout service where duplicate orders are created."; list every doc that references the old behaviour.

validation: No stale references to old behaviour

ai_assist.prompt: Review the diff for "Fix the bug in the existing checkout service where duplicate orders are created." for regressions, security and performance impact; suggest a safe rollout.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Owns release decision and rollback plan.

risks.risk: Behavioural regression in code the change does not obviously touch.
risks.mitigation: Characterization tests before change; full suite must be green.

risks.risk: Hidden callers depend on current (buggy) behaviour.
risks.mitigation: Search for all usages; communicate behaviour changes in the changelog.

risks.risk: AI output looks plausible but is incorrect or uses non-existent APIs.
risks.mitigation: Every generated unit is run, type-checked and covered by tests before acceptance.

risks.risk: AI-written tests may be tautological and miss gaps (coverage illusion).
risks.mitigation: Engineer breaks the code deliberately to confirm tests fail; coverage is a floor, not proof.

risks.risk: Inefficient or insecure patterns (N+1 queries, string-built SQL, weak randomness).
risks.mitigation: Checklist review for SQL, randomness, input validation and complexity; separate AI review pass.

risks.risk: Sensitive data or proprietary code exposed to AI tools.
risks.mitigation: Prompts contain requirements and snippets only; no secrets or customer data.

trade_offs.rationale: Reproducible and reviewable; less flexible. LLM output would still need engineer review.

trade_offs.chosen: Contract and tests before wide implementation
trade_offs.rationale: Slower start, fewer rework cycles and clearer acceptance criteria.

limitations: Plans are templates tailored by keyword detection, not deep semantic understanding.
AI prompts are generated for an engineer to run in Copilot/ChatGPT; the tool calls no model itself.
